subject: API/OpenRouter backend: daemon-driven in-process judge loop (AV-clean, no child process)
description:
Implement the real 'api'-kind backend in lib/llm-backend.js (currently throwing stubs callApi/runJudgeLoop). Builds on the seam /14 + the drain-routing/api-skip from /16 (both merged into orch/feature/pluggable-backend). Branch off the feature.
1. callApi(messages/opts): in-process HTTPS call to a hosted LLM (OpenRouter-style: POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with Authorization: Bearer <key>, model from overlay.config.backend.model). Use Node's built-in https/fetch — NO child process. Return parsed text/usage.
2. runJudgeLoop(...): the in-process equivalent of the agentic judge — given the judge work item (node + edges to adjudicate, or the eager/periodic judge prompt the spawn path uses), drive the verdict by calling callApi and returning the same verdict shape the spawn-based judge produces, so headless-drain.js's judge drain can use it interchangeably. NO spawn, NO console window (this is the AV-clean path — the whole point).
3. Wire into lib/headless-drain.js: for an api-kind active backend, the judge drain calls runJudgeLoop in-process INSTEAD of the spawn path — replace /16's skipped:'api_backend_not_implemented' guard with the real in-process call. Keep the agentic-cli (Claude/Codex/Cursor) spawn path unchanged. Preserve backoff + per-tick cap + flag-off default.
4. API key: read from overlay.config.backend (a key field) or env (OPENROUTER_API_KEY); isAuthed reflects presence. Hard-block (no_backend) still applies if unauthed.
5. Tests: callApi (mock the HTTP), runJudgeLoop returns a valid verdict shape, headless-drain judge drain uses runJudgeLoop (not spawn) for api-kind, isAuthed gating. node --check clean. SCOPE: only the api provider impl + its drain wiring — NOT the dashboard, NOT Codex/Cursor. Blocked by /16.

summary: Implemented the real IN-PROCESS OpenRouter (kind 'api') backend in lib/llm-backend.js, replacing the throwing stubs. callApi(opts): in-process HTTPS POST to openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions (Bearer auth, model from overlay.config.backend.model or default), returns {text,usage}; non-200/network/timeout throw a typed ApiBackendError carrying .throttle (429/503/529) so the drain backoff governor treats it like a spawned-child throttle. runJudgeLoop(args): in-process analogue of the spawned judge — walks GET /judge/next -> callApi (reason items) -> POST /judge/verdict over Node http, returns the SAME drain-result shape {exitCode,stdout,stderr,timedOut,spawnError} the spawn path produces; a throttle surfaces in stderr. NO child_process anywhere on the api path. Auth: opts.key or OPENROUTER_API_KEY/OPENROUTER_KEY; isAuthed reflects key presence. Wired into lib/headless-drain.js: resolveJudgeBackend dropped skip:'api_backend_not_implemented' — an authed api backend now resolves to kind:'api' and _runOneJudge calls provider.runJudgeLoop in-process (no spawn), feeding recordDrainOutcome + the per-tick cap + iteration/concurrency caps identically to a spawn; an unauthed api backend hard-blocks with skip:'no_backend'. The agentic-cli spawn path, backoff gate, and ORCH_HEADLESS_DRAINS default-OFF are unchanged. Tests: 88/88 green across test/llm-backend.test.js + test/headless-drain.test.js, including a child_process tripwire proving the api path spawns NO child, 429->throttle mapping, idle/daemonUrl guards, drain-uses-runJudgeLoop-not-spawn, unauthed hard-block, throwing-adapter-degrades-cleanly, and api-throttle-feeds-backoff. node --check clean on all 4 files + routes/config.js + lib/claude-cli.js. Committed cf7ea56 on orch/attempt/4b12fe1f-4bef-4c82-908d-0f07f56f3638-18 (1 ahead of feature base). Scope fence respected: no dashboard, no Codex/Cursor, agentic-cli behavior untouched.
